title: Triangle Angle Sum, Exterior Angles and Isosceles Triangles

key_big: Angles add to 180°; exterior = sum of remote interior.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • The angles of a triangle add to 180°.
  • An exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles.
  • The base angles of an isosceles triangle are congruent. Each angle of an equilateral triangle is 60°.

Examples

Example

Remote angles 47° and 68°

47 + 68

Answer: exterior angle 115°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding the exterior angle to the remote anglesThe exterior angle equals their sum.
Using the vertex angle as a base angleBase angles are opposite the equal sides.
Forgetting 180°All three angles add to 180°.

items.q: One acute angle of a right triangle measures 65°. What is the other acute angle?
items.e: The acute angles of a right triangle are complementary (90° + the two acute angles = 180°). 90° − 65° = 25°.

items.e: The truss is an isosceles triangle, so the base angles are equal: (180 − 140) ÷ 2 = 20°.
